input: Write the staff notice for the first fire drill at Riverside House
output:
First fire drill at Riverside House

The drill is on Wednesday 9 December 2026 at 10:30 and takes about 15 minutes.

When the alarm sounds:
- Leave by the nearest stairs. Do not use the lift.
- Leave your belongings.
- Follow the instructions of your floor's fire wardens. There are two on each floor, wearing yellow vests.
- Go to the assembly point in the car park on the Canal Street side, marked 'Assembly point B'.

If you may need help to leave the building in an emergency, please ask facilities (facilities@example.com) for a personal evacuation plan before Monday 7 December. Evacuation chairs are at every stairwell, and trained wardens will help anyone with a plan.
